$comment: Central feature registry. One entry per user-facing feature. Every code change that adds/alters a feature updates its entry (and the README feature guide + CHANGELOG) in the same PR. `./gradlew checkDocs` audits this file against README.md, docs/img/, and the source tree, and prints the documentation-gap report. `code`/`tests` paths are relative to src/main/java/com/loadoutlab and src/test/java/com/loadoutlab respectively; `anchor` must equal the slugified '### ' heading of the feature's section in the README '# Feature guide'.

features.title: Best owned set per style
features.notes: 2026-10-20 (Andrew: 'why is it simming mythical cape over fire cape' - the Mythical cape's +6 crush beat the fire cape's +3 strength by ~0.1% with the Obligator): the dps-neutral polish accepts a higher prayer-then-defence piece while the set stays within 0.5% of its original dps, all the old guards kept (NearTieTest). 2026-10-20 (Andrew's Copy report: simmed crossbows lost to the blowpipe at the Gemstone Crab with a ~1,000-item bank): the raw-stat weapon shortlist (24) ranked the Ascension crossbows 126th of 193 ranged weapons - their strength is in the bolts - so shortlist_boosts.json lifts them like the crystal bow family; on his saved profile they now win the crab at 12.40 over the blowpipe's 11.58 (AscensionShortlistTest). 2026-10-20 (Andrew: model as much as possible, rough edges expected the first week): the Obligator lunges for the best of 2-4 damage rolls by crush's rank among the target's melee defences, +20/40% on 2x2/3x3, or smashes at 3 ticks, whichever is better (RollMath.bestOfExpected; a shortlist boost keeps it past the raw-stat cut) - it takes game-best melee at Cerberus, Araxxor, the Nightmare and most of the Archive (ObligatorTest); Zorya's tome special buffs three 2-tick follow-ups, their time charged to the spec (BUFFED_FOLLOWUPS, 50% energy assumed; ZoryaSpecTest). Token room from three tables moved to data: powered_staves.json, spell_staves.json, shortlist_boosts.json. 2026-10-20 (Andrew: is BiS considering the new raid gear?): the Fractured Archive's tradeable rewards were never in the game-best pool - ALL_STANDARD needs a price and the intake wrote none - so scripts/wiki_intake.py now prices them from the wiki's real-time feed, falling back to the GE guide price before the first trade, and reads tradeable per version (TfaIntakeTest). 2026-10-20: the Fractured Archive rewards - Zorya's tome a 3-tick powered staff with a flat base of 18 (ZoryaTomeTest), the Ascension crossbows a 3-tick crossbow (2 on rapid) that fires ascension bolts only (AscensionCrossbowsTest), the Obligator a plain 5-tick crush two-hander for now. 2026-10-06 game-update audit: seeking arrows land for at least 3 (the 0, 1 and 2 rolls lift; SeekingArrowsTest, official vectors); corpus refreshed to the 2026-09-02 weirdgloop data. 2026-10-01 (Kendyy / Micah, Discord): ToA-only stats - the keris partisan of Amascut loses 50 stab and 22 strength outside the Tombs (it won aquanite cards on its inside stats); Tumeken's shadow multiplies by four inside the Tombs, three elsewhere (ToaGearRulesTest, official vectors). 2026-09-27 (N, Discord): two-hit weapons - sulphur blades, glacial temotli, earthbound tecpatl and Torag's hammers roll two independent hits on the halved max (flat armour per hitsplat); the dark bow fires two full arrows; Tonalztics roll 75% and the charged pair throws twice (wiki Multi-hit weapons, official calc agrees). No dedicated screenshot: the style card is visible in the game-best, optimize-modes, and incoming-damage shots. 2026-07-16: style card headers show the skill SPRITE icon (Staticons attack/ranged/magic, AssumeIcons.styleSprite) instead of the style word - sprites not glyphs (Tahoe tofu rule), tooltip carries the word. 2026-07-16 (M-2c): the classic worn-equipment layout is THE layout (compact grid + config option removed); the grid blanks host info tiles - max hit (top-left), accuracy (top-right), incoming dps with the protect-prayer sprite and full threat tooltip (right of legs). 2026-07-31 (0.3.4): the footnote's 'Wiki calc' chip and its shortlink POST (WikiCalcLink) are held out of the Plugin Hub build - new network I/O forces manual maintainer review; it returns in its own hub PR. 2026-10-18 (TRIPLEKILLTRENT, YouTube: 'salad blade is better than my fang at toa'): inside the Tombs the fang rolls accuracy twice (1 - (1-p)^2) instead of the outside reroll formula; vectors fang-baba-i300 / fang-warden3-i300 went from -17.4% / -23.7% to exact (FangToaTest). 2026-10-18 (TonyDAnnunzio, YouTube: 'it just says computing now'): a throw inside the optimizer worker used to drop the callback and leave the card on Computing for good; both worker paths now catch, log the mob and answer empty (ThrowingComputeTest), so the empty state and Reload take over. 2026-10-19 (Muuffin, Discord: Rada's blessing 3 lost to the god blessings it stat-ties with): in betterEquivalent a Rada's blessing wins a stat tie against any other blessing, after the ownership check and before the tradeable preference (RadasBlessingTest).

features.title: Incoming damage and protection prayer
features.capture: Zulrah or K'ril card with the incoming-DPS line and protect-prayer icon visible (Calvar'ion's '(unavoidable)' works too). Single PNG screenshot.
features.notes: 2026-10-29 (Andrew's first in-game pass: 'should be in the output card itself'; 'it should be the statistical P90'; 'Median: XX:XX / 90% of runs fall between: XX:XX - XX:XX (P05-P95)'; 'list individual and group kill times in the card consecutively'): the kill time sits in the card's stat column - a single mob's Kill line, a group's member lines then its Trip line - each hover Median, the P05-P95 band and Perfect; the band is the 5th and 95th percentile of a table over the set's REAL damage distribution (engine/HitDist, built beside the calculator's expected maths once per shown card in OptimizerService.verified and kept only when its mean reproduces the card's expected hit; HitDistTest pins that over every standard weapon and 26 special sets), with keris sun, the vents' floor and a multi-hit weapon's sure hits on a tormented demon the paced, approximate exceptions. Rendered by the in-core surface (render/RenderSurface.java + ResultCards.java) - single plugin since the 2026-08 merge-back (hub ruling on PR #15129). 2026-10-21 data hygiene (layer 1 of the defensive rebuild, ISS-01M5FZ3KYCGEMMX1A45D3J9NQ9): the wiki's listed max hits are read per family (MaxHits) and beat the stat formula (Vardorvis 37 not 1, Aberrant spectre 8 not 11); corpus style spellings are normalised (Typeless X / 100% prayer penetration = X's accuracy, never prayed off; Melee (Slash); DEL noise; None/N/A = does not attack); speed 0/-1 is unknown, never one tick; unmodeled styles take no share; the card shows coverage - '~X.X' full or curated, '~X.X*' partial with the uncounted attacks in the tooltip, 'DTPS: ?' unknown. Prepared (the beam scorer) is parity-swept against calculate() over the whole corpus, which also fixed it counting avoidable curated attacks (Zulrah Magma). 2026-10-21 dev-mode prototype (ISS-01M5G5CZC9SK46499FACRSJ8ZT): the player defence roll is Defence + 8 (+ stance, 0 assumed) and magic floor(0.7 Magic) + floor(0.3 Defence) + 8 - the official calc's Abyssal demon vectors to 4 decimals; the 491b6c0 scaffolding is back (defenseWeight, weighted beam, defensive candidate tier) behind OptimizeMode: Tanky = least DTPS, Balanced = least DTPS/DPS (Andrew's definitions), ties to DPS, only where coverage is full or curated, the card shows the DPS cost. The chip and the mode exist only in RuneLite developer mode. 2026-10-29 (KendyyOP, Discord: "Moons giving the same gear for all 3 options DPS, balanced and tanky"): the style's prayer raises the levels the boss rolls against - Zeal, Piety and Rigour +25% Defence, Chivalry +20%, Augury +25% Defence and Magic, Deadeye and Mystic Vigour +5% Defence, the Mystic prayers their Magic boost (prayer_picks.json percents, osrs-dps-calc Prayer.ts) - on the cards, the modes, the swaps and the defense-weighted beam alike, using the prayer the card assumes, the player's pick first (PrayerBonuses.defending; PrayerDefenceTest, IncomingPrayerTest). A group search (the Moons of Peril) runs them too (ISS-01M64GNB852CBYVVWE29A9HJK4, Andrew: "Parity now"): each member's sweep pick feeds the trip kit, which the DPS rules build (slot unification may not raise a member's damage taken), then each member wears its mode-best combination of what the trip carries, and its trade reads against its card in the group's Max DPS answer, signed ("Tanky +3%" when the group's kit gives it more DPS) (GroupModesTest, ModeTabsTest). The group's swap strip and shared spec stay DPS-ranked. 2026-10-29 kill time (ISS-01M6415DTE84ZZ45C4YD3MZRBJ, Andrew: "make the time to kill as low as possible and not necessarily output the most dps"): a curated attack may heal the boss off what lands (heal {factor, min, max}; chain = a stack where one miss ends the rest), Blood Moon's three-hit stack first; every set carries net DPS (dps minus the heal/s off that set) and every ranking - the beam, polish, the strips, the modes, the group's shared set, swaps and kit - reads net, so where nothing heals nothing changes; the card's DPS stays what the set deals. Each card gets a Kill line: the P50 kill time from a tick table over the set's attacks (uniform 0..max at the card's accuracy, the heal and the sustained spec riding between attacks; a non-uniform hit model is scaled to its mean and marked approximate), with P10, P90, Perfect (every hit a max, no heal) and the heal on hover; a group lists the trip's combined time under the members, the tables convolved (KillTimeTest, HealRuleTest, KillTimeRankingTest, KillTimeLineTest).

features.capture: Magic card with the recommended autocast spell icon visible and the spellbook dropdown open. Single PNG screenshot.
features.notes: 2026-10-15 (Andrew): a mob's fight book (monster_spellbooks.json, the Sire's Ancients) is the autocast lock unless the player locked a book or pinned a spell - the Sire's magic set had cast Dark Demonbane from Arceuus (FightBookLockTest). Rendered by the in-core surface (render/RenderSurface.java + ResultCards.java) - single plugin since the 2026-08 merge-back (hub ruling on PR #15129). 2026-09-08: the spellbook LOCK control returns to the spell picker (a Spellbook row: any / standard / ancient / lunar / arceuus -> set-param spellbookLock; the merge-back had dropped the control while the engine kept honouring the param). A lock with no autocast spell (Lunar for Cure Me) leaves the card to built-in staves; a pinned built-in staff casts its own spell even under a pinned spell (Apathy, Discord 2026-09-06). 2026-10-18 (rakaykhan1512, YouTube/Discord: the tome of water lost to Elidinis' ward on Water Surge at drakes): the charged tomes of water, fire and earth add +10% accuracy and a x1.10 damage step (after the magic damage pool) to a standard-spellbook spell of their element vs NPCs (wiki Tome of Water; empty tomes, off-element spells and Ancients get nothing); charged tomes bypass the magic shield pool's score prune and stat dedupe so the spell-matched one is always available (TomeTest; official vector watersurge-tome-drake). 2026-10-19 (Kendyy's follow-up): the accuracy step belongs to the water tome alone; fire and earth tomes boost damage only (all three wiki pages; TomeTest pins a fire tome's accuracy equal to bare). 2026-10-19 (Kendyy): sunfire runes - OptimizationRequest.sunfireRunes gives a standard fire spell a minimum hit of a tenth of its pre-tome max (DpsCalculator, official MIN_HIT_SUNFIRE ordering; RollMath.expectedHit prices the hit uniform over [min, max]); a page param seeded from ownership at selection (CommandEngine.seedSunfire, detect-sunfire), a sunfire plate on fire-spell cards (ResultCards.sunfirePlate), the trip runes swap fire for sunfire runes (SpellRunes.withSunfire) and the Best-in-game card always assumes them (SunfireTest, SunfireAssumptionTest; official vectors firesurge-sunfire-araxxor and firesurge-sunfire-tome-araxxor). 2026-10-19 (Andrew, client test: a simmed sunfire rune did not seed the plate): a sim counts as owned for every detection - the plugin's owned check unions the dream store (LoadoutLabPlugin.ownsOrSimmed, also the dragonfire tier) and the engine's seed reads the page's simmed ids (CommandEngine.isSimmed); the Copy report prints 'Sunfire runes: yes/no'.

features.title: Mob profiles: pins, notes, and bank-filter items
features.notes: 2026-10-21 SLOT LADDER (ISS-01M5GE9EJSX6YWCKMSYEWKZ132, Andrew): a left click on a Yours slot cell opens its ladder as a strip under the gear grid (ISS-01M5GHXXEZKX8S68M5X9DHY6ME, concept A: bars sized by the step's gain, owned steps grey on the left, the worn item, upgrades green on the right, unowned ones dashed; the open slot is view state, never undo history) - the two items just above the worn one (any item, with price) and the two just below (owned or simmed only), each swapped in alone with the rest fixed and ranked by the active mode (DPS; damage taken for Tanky; DTPS/DPS for Balanced). A left click on an unowned step sims it for this monster - no pin (ISS-01M5J93WTVB37DP9HV1K9S1RH8, Andrew 2026-10-22: "we are using pin for this mob instead of sim for this mob"; it superseded the 2026-10-21 sim + pin); your own steps have no click, their menu keeps an explicit pin (ladder-try: pin, or pinned spec on the spec strip, LadderTryTest); its right-click menu adds Sim everywhere and How to get it, which opens Not Enough Runes on the item (PluginMessage notenoughrunes/displayItemById) when NER is enabled (SlotLadderTest, LadderNerTest, LadderStripTest). The strip is centred across the card on a rounded inset, bars on one baseline, the worn column highlighted. In game it is the slot's "swaps" (ISS-01M5H13V0TVF58RHPHT8WQ1GFP, Andrew: not "ladder") and always shows five columns when the steps exist: two each way, a short side's spare spots going to the other (BiS worn = the four below). A weapon step the worn ammo does not fit brings its best usable ammo (ISS-01M5H2AH8ERQG471AZY3S67FKW, Andrew: the bowfa showed no twisted bow), named on the step as "with <ammo>". Ties under the mode rank by the item's own stats (ISS-01M5H9KGF4FSAM5DR1XSD9F9RX): a tied better-stats item is a "same" step up ('='), your equal-DPS items stand side by side; Balanced steps show DPS and damage-taken changes; the strip fits the 225 px panel. The spec cell has its own strip (ISS-01M5HCS725N7XVVBC7CMK6Y43A): spec weapons ranked by the DPS each adds, a try sims it and makes it the mob's pinned spec, and the spec cell keeps its own Pin-as-spec menu. Pin, unpin and try act on the monster the card shows, roster rows included, and Unpin clears the slot in every scope (ISS-01M5HANBV7VC08XCH850AW7Q39). Pins are visible and tied to sims (ISS-01M5HJ84ADBHWB2302G66WW2G4, Andrew: a tried fang stayed pinned after its sim went): a gold pin badge on pinned cells, a pin list on the mob line (^ - remove, Clear all, pin an item into its own slot, all undoable), and removing a sim - one, all, or the global toggle - unpins the item on the mob unless it is still yours (PinsTiedToSimsTest). 2026-10-14 (Apathy, Discord, Tormented Demons): the profile store normalises every id through Monster.profileIdOf, so a pin, pinned spell or spec set on a phase card lands on the real monster and the roster compute finds it; entries stranded under variant ids fold in on load. Same day, mixed rosters: computeRoster hands bestPerStyleAcross per-member maps keyed by profileId (pinsByMob / spellByMob / specByMob, travelling like per-mob exclusions and sims), each member's request and cache keys read its own, the first member's pinned spec is the shared spec, and calcRespecting refuses a member's shown set that breaks its pin so the dps-greedy shared set and swap passes cannot drop it (RosterPinsTest). Per-monster remembered preferences, scoped per set or all sets. PINS (any slot, owned or not, picked via the NATIVE chatbox item search or the cell's Pin submenu): the slot has exactly one candidate, bypassing exclusions/mode/budget and the low-risk vetoes (risk totals stay honest; the cap constrains the REST via a pinned-risk floor); a style-scoped pin overlays the all-sets pin on its own card; pins shape YOUR sets only - game best stays the pure ceiling. NOTE: a collapsible post-it, edited inline (saves on focus loss), togglable off in the plugin settings ('Per-monster notes'). FILTER ITEMS: per-set or all-sets supplies (super combat on the melee card, ranged potion on ranged) unioned into that card's Show/Filter bank. Entry points live ON the style cards (header dots menu + cell right-click) and the 'This mob' line. Each trio list menu ends with 'Clear all (N)' (2026-09-18, Andrew: 'reset all in list option'): one clear-mob-list command, one recompute, one undo step that re-adds every entry with its scope (ClearMobListTest). Style cards themselves collapse to a dps header - auto-collapsed when a standard deviation under the best set. The magic card hosts the spellbook lock and a per-mob SPELL PIN (forced autocast via the engine's existing forced-spell path; gear optimizes around it).

features.title: Wilderness low-risk sets
features.notes: 2026-10-21 (Ragnarrok2023, YouTube: '3 iteming' on PvP worlds): a pvpWorld param (0 off, 1 PvP, 2 High Risk) turns the risk model on for ANY mob - kept slots 3/4, High Risk 0 and no Protect Item chip (wiki) - plus the locked-pouch rule, blighted Detect-best supplies and the no-heart boost pick; it never sets inWilderness, so no wilderness weapon buff. Seeded from the client's world type on a flip (the f2p rule); the PvP chip shows on a PvP world, while on, or with the 'PvP world chip' setting. Untradeable fees stay at the deep-Wilderness rate (wiki: under-20 rules apply there - an upper bound, said in the risk chip's tooltip). 0.2.0: untradeable_death.json gains curated frictionGp (rebuild-errand proxies for the salve line, imbued rings/masks) counted into riskGp and convert pool values, and low-risk sets NEVER put a friction item at risk (PvpRisk.risksUnprotected rejects unprotected ones outright, any cap; protected kept-slot rides stay legal). Tooltips say 'breaks on death (rebuild errand ~X)'.

features.capture: The grey ~ chip's menu open above the search bar showing the six supply submenus and the always-filter entries, beside a card with the red/green/grey trio chips. Single PNG screenshot.
features.notes: 2026-10-20 (Andrew: 'suggesting dwarf multicannon for barrows even though it's not allowed'): the cannon skips any selection with a mob on noCannonMonsters (trip_supplies.json, exact names) - the wiki's cannon-immune monsters, the bosses of the Dwarf multicannon page's prohibited areas and the cannon-destroying bosses, and Barrows on Andrew's in-game word (CannonKitTest). 2026-10-15 (Andrew, live in 0.5.4): the rune pouch source marked the ledger dirty every tick, which starved the quiet-tick refresh, so a card computed before the bank scan kept empty Detect-best supplies; the pouch now goes dirty only on a change (LoadoutLabPlugin.onGameTick). MultiMobs.isMultiAble gates the chip (crowds only since 2026-10-19: a listed location needs three or more spawns, so a boss alone in a multi area such as Graardor or the Kings gets no chip); multiView is a compute param (ComputeParams), multiStack a view param. The compute runs the three MultiTool rows through the per-style pipeline with the tool pinned (OptimizerService.multiToolResult: Ice Barrage/Burst by level, best owned chin / black for the ceiling, the charged venator bow; Yours empty when the tool is not owned) and hangs them on StyleResult.multiTools; RenderModel emits them unscaled under 'multi'; CommandEngine.multiView scales by MultiTool.factor (area: stack up to 9; chain: RollMath.venatorFactor = 1 + 2 x E(floor(2m/3)) / E(m), wiki Venator bow) and swaps them in as the styles, so the card, strip and best-tab logic render them unchanged; RenderSurface's chip row carries the control as a cycling pill Single / Multi x3 / Multi x9 beside the other search chips (Andrew 2026-10-19: not a header chip) and ResultCards.styleHeader shows the factor; the Copy report prints a Multi section.
